text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, I happened to see Cheval Grand 
training late.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Alright. 3 more sets... 
no, 5 more!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!?? ...Ah, um... I-I'm sorry...! I-I was, 
well...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'll go run now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling concerned, I watched over her 
training. And then... I noticed something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking proper breaks while repeating slope 
dashes, Cheval Grand was putting in 
appropriate effort, strictly within safe, 
reasonable limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What drove her to work so genuinely hard? 
I couldn't help but feel intrigued by her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Welcome back. Um, you're back late 
today too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm sorry. B-But... the mock race is 
coming up soon, so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me... has to try harder, 
or... I won't even stand a chance, so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I get it. You feel like to catch 
up, you gotta put in more time than 
everyone else, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Keep giving it your all until 
you're satisfied! 'Cause I think that 
feeling is super important!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Th-Thank you very much... I-I'm, 
well...——

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...J-Just a little more! I'm going to 
run...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. I headed over to the stands 
to watch Cheval Grand's mock race.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list:
Did you two come to watch Cheval Grand as 
well?

Did you two come to watch Cheval Grand as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, it's my precious sister's 
mock race. There's no way I could miss it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I've watched her put in all that effort 
until now. So in today's race, I'm sure 
she will——
choice_data_list: She's a real hard worker, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. More than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's something she struggles 
with... once she decides to do it, she has 
the strength to see it through to the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... She has the grit to achieve her 
goals——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to bear witness. To see just how 
much she has honed herself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...She evaluates herself very harshly. 
However, because of that——

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She excels at holding herself to strict 
standards.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan! Let's have a great race 
today! I'm going all out!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Um... ......L-Looking forward to 
it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I know how useless I am. I know I can 
never be like everyone else...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(But that's why... that's exactly why. 
Working hard is the one thing I've always 
done, so... Today——)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...*deep breath in*... *deep breath 
out*...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I will run. With everything I have.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race. Having spotted Cheval 
Grand, I called out to her.
choice_data_list: Good work out there. That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Th-Thank you very much... Um... 
I'm, so happy...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I know I still have a long way to go... 
B-But... this time... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I think I managed to run properly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race. Having spotted Cheval 
Grand, I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Um, ah... I-Is that... so...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I still feel like I could have pushed 
harder... So next time, even more——

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Because that's the only thing I can 
do...
